StartDate.represented_event: final close time of validated ledger 77

StartDate.reason: Pinned LoanSet copies the applying view header closeTime. The observed Loan therefore establishes that header value as 845357133; the parent ledger was 845357123 and the source-defined successor construction used a 10-second increment.

NextPaymentDueDate.reason: Pinned LoanSet initializes NextPaymentDueDate as StartDate + PaymentInterval: 845357133 + 60 = 845357193.

nine_second_offset.frozen_anchor_event: final accepted close time of ledger 77 and committed transaction date
nine_second_offset.protocol_anchor_event: ledger 77 in-construction applying-view header closeTime copied into Loan.StartDate before acceptance
nine_second_offset.cause: The frozen oracle compared the persisted pre-acceptance applying-view time with the post-application accepted ledger close time. buildLedgerImpl applies transactions before Ledger::setAccepted replaces the header closeTime.

recommendation: Do not bind StartDate to the validated transaction date or another pre-submission timestamp.
Assert StartDate equals the protocol-defined applying-view header closeTime when that value is independently captured or source-reconstructable.
Always assert NextPaymentDueDate equals StartDate plus PaymentInterval.
Assert GracePeriod independently and, where lifecycle behavior is exercised, assert the source-defined boundary at NextPaymentDueDate plus GracePeriod.
